_comment: Generic hooks template - copy to .claude/hooks/config.json and customize

preToolUse.command: bash -c 'if [[ "$COMMAND" =~ git\ push ]]; then echo "🛑 Pre-push validation..."; if [ -f "package.json" ]; then npm test > /tmp/test.log 2>&1 || { echo "❌ TESTS FAILED:"; tail -20 /tmp/test.log; exit 1; }; echo "✅ Tests passed"; elif [ -f "pyproject.toml" ] || [ -f "setup.py" ]; then python -m pytest > /tmp/test.log 2>&1 || { echo "❌ TESTS FAILED:"; tail -20 /tmp/test.log; exit 1; }; echo "✅ Tests passed"; fi; fi'

preToolUse.description: Warn about MCP tool access in sub-agents
preToolUse.command: bash -c 'if echo "$PROMPT" | grep -qE "mcp__" && ! echo "$PROMPT" | grep -q "ToolSearch"; then echo "⚠️  Sub-agent may need ToolSearch for MCP tools"; echo "💡 Pattern: Use ToolSearch to load mcp__ tools, THEN execute task"; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$OLD_STRING" | grep -qE "(import|require|def |class |function )" && ! echo "$NEW_STRING" | grep -qE "(import|require|def |class |function )"; then echo "⚠️  Removed import/function/class. Verify it is unused."; fi'

postToolUse.command: bash -c 'if command -v eslint &> /dev/null; then eslint "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -15 || echo "✅ No lint errors"; fi'

bash -c 'if command -v ruff &> /dev/null; then ruff check "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -15 || echo "✅ No lint errors"; elif command -v flake8 &> /dev/null; then flake8 "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -15 || echo "✅ No lint errors"; fi'

sessionStart.command: bash -c 'if [ -f "CLAUDE.md" ]; then echo "📋 Project: $(basename $PWD)"; echo "💡 Remember to read CLAUDE.md for project-specific rules"; fi'

sessionEnd.command:
echo "
📋 Before ending:
- [ ] Update CLAUDE.md with learnings?
- [ ] Tests/builds passing?
- [ ] Write continuation prompt if needed?"
